## VSUMM: A mechanism designed to produce static video summaries and a novel evaluation method

- **Venue:** Pattern Recognition Letters 32(1), 56–68; online publication 2010
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://ic.unicamp.br/~sandra/pdf/papers/avila_PRL11.pdf)
- **Project url:** [project url](https://github.com/sandraavila/vsumm)
- **Encoders:** Handcrafted 16-bin HSV hue histograms; no pretrained neural encoder
- **Sampling:** One frame per second; remove near-monochromatic frames using feature variation
- **Architecture:** Cluster sampled frames; VSUMM1 uses all clusters; VSUMM2 retains clusters larger than half the average cluster size.
- **Fusion:** Visual-only histogram representation
- **Objective:** Section 3: per-video Euclidean k-means clustering with sequential initialization; no learned human-importance objective.
- **Training data:** No separate labelled training corpus
- **Test data:** 50 Open Video videos and 50 web videos in the original release
- **Split:** No supervised train/test split
- **Budget:** Variable keyframe count; no native 15% temporal budget
- **Postprocessing:** Choose centroid-nearest frames, remove similar keyframes and restore chronological order.
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/sandraavila/vsumm)
- **Code status:** Official data and CUS evaluation repository verified; complete summarizer source not independently verified
- **Framework:** CUS evaluator: Java with jai_core and jai_codec dependencies; summarizer framework Not reported
- **Weights:** Not applicable to handcrafted selector
- **Features:** Histogram features computed by the method; dataset release supplies media and user summaries.
- **Reproducibility:** Paper and official repository read; linked archives and Java evaluator were not downloaded or executed.
- **Limitations:** Static color-based matching can miss semantic equivalence. Extending selected frames into shots changes both the output and evaluation.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Authors:** Sandra Eliza Fontes de Avila; Ana Paula Brandão Lopes; Antonio da Luz Jr.; Arnaldo de Albuquerque Araújo
- **Year:** 2011
- **Supervision:** unsupervised
- **Tasks:** Generic static video summarization
- **Outputs:** Selected keyframe set
- **Mechanisms:** Color histograms; Modified k-means; Redundancy removal
- **Metrics:** CUS content matching; CUSA; CUSE
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://ic.unicamp.br/~sandra/pdf/papers/avila_PRL11.pdf) · [source 2](https://github.com/sandraavila/vsumm)

<a id="seqdpp"></a>

## Diverse Sequential Subset Selection for Supervised Video Summarization

- **Venue:** Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 27 (NIPS 2014)
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~grauman/papers/nips14_seqdpp.pdf)
- **Project url:** [project url](https://github.com/pujols/Video-summarization)
- **Encoders:** 8192-D SIFT Fisher vectors, saliency and local context-correlation features
- **Sampling:** 1 fps, followed by candidate pruning
- **Architecture:** A conditional DPP selects within each temporal segment given the preceding selected subset; linear or tanh embeddings parameterize the kernel.
- **Fusion:** Handcrafted visual, saliency and context descriptors
- **Objective:** Maximum likelihood of oracle keyframe subsets under the sequential DPP factorization (Section 3, Eq. 8). Oracles are derived from human references.
- **Training data:** OVP, 39-video non-cartoon YouTube subset, and Kodak; dataset-specific training subsets
- **Test data:** OVP 50, YouTube 39, Kodak 18
- **Split:** 100 random 80/20 training/test trials per dataset
- **Budget:** Variable subset size; no universal 15% temporal budget
- **Postprocessing:** Approximate sequential MAP selection; no claim of exact global DPP MAP.
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/pujols/Video-summarization)
- **Code status:** Official MATLAB implementation and feature/oracle download advertised; source README inspected
- **Framework:** MATLAB; minFunc_2012 optimization; Java CUS evaluation dependencies
- **Weights:** Not independently verified
- **Features:** Author Dropbox package advertises Fisher features, saliency, context features, histograms, oracle and ground sets: https://www.dropbox.com/s/bpy41o2zglk4ka4/video_summarization.zip?dl=0
- **Reproducibility:** Primary paper and official seqDPP README read; Dropbox bytes, feature integrity and MATLAB execution not independently verified.
- **Limitations:** Local temporal conditioning does not enforce arbitrary long-range diversity. Human-reference oracle construction is part of training.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Authors:** Boqing Gong; Wei-Lun Chao; Kristen Grauman; Fei Sha
- **Year:** 2014
- **Supervision:** supervised
- **Tasks:** Generic static video summarization
- **Outputs:** Selected keyframe set
- **Mechanisms:** Sequential determinantal point process; Learned diversity kernel
- **Metrics:** Content-matched keyframe precision; Content-matched keyframe recall; Content-matched keyframe F1
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~grauman/papers/nips14_seqdpp.pdf) · [source 2](https://github.com/pujols/Video-summarization/blob/master/seqDPP/Readme_seqDPP.txt)

<a id="cosum"></a>

## Video Co-summarization: Video Summarization by Visual Co-occurrence

- **Venue:** CVPR 2015
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://people.csail.mit.edu/yalesong/publications/ChuSJ2015CVPR.pdf)
- **Project url:** [project url](https://github.com/l2ior/cosum)
- **Encoders:** CENTRIST, Dense-SIFT and HSV moments; concatenate and PCA-reduce to 400-D
- **Sampling:** Provided shot boundaries; exact frame sampling Not independently verified
- **Architecture:** Find mutually similar shot groups across topic-related videos using a bipartite graph.
- **Fusion:** Visual descriptors from multiple videos
- **Objective:** Section 3.4, Eq. 4: maximize weighted co-occurrence minus L1 sparsity penalties under pairwise similarity constraints; relaxed alternating updates.
- **Training data:** No human-summary training labels; joint optimization on the input video group
- **Test data:** CoSum: 51 video instances in ten groups; additional CMU-Mocap experiment
- **Split:** Collection-level unsupervised setting; no canonical training/test partition
- **Budget:** Evaluate top five and top fifteen shots
- **Postprocessing:** Rank shots by co-occurrence quality; select highest-ranked shots
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/l2ior/cosum)
- **Code status:** Official dataset/annotation and shot-index release; full algorithm implementation not independently verified
- **Framework:** Not independently verified
- **Weights:** Not independently verified
- **Features:** Paper describes handcrafted descriptors; ready-made tensor release not found in inspected repository
- **Reproducibility:** Paper and official data README inspected; video URLs were not downloaded.
- **Limitations:** Repeated visual content is a relevance proxy; source groups influence the summary. Input-group access must be recorded.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Authors:** Wen-Sheng Chu; Yale Song; Alejandro Jaimes
- **Year:** 2015
- **Supervision:** unsupervised
- **Tasks:** Multi-video co-summarization; Query-specific video summarization
- **Outputs:** Ranked shots per video
- **Mechanisms:** Cross-video visual co-occurrence; Maximal biclique finding; Sparse graph selection
- **Metrics:** mAP@5 shots; mAP@15 shots; Human concept-visualization ratings
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://people.csail.mit.edu/yalesong/publications/ChuSJ2015CVPR.pdf) · [source 2](https://github.com/l2ior/cosum)

## Video Summarization by Learning Submodular Mixtures of Objectives

- **Venue:** CVPR 2015, 3090–3098
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://www.cv-foundation.org/openaccess/content_cvpr_2015/papers/Gygli_Video_Summarization_by_2015_CVPR_paper.pdf)
- **Project url:** [project url](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content_cvpr_2015/html/Gygli_Video_Summarization_by_2015_CVPR_paper.html)
- **Encoders:** DeCAF visual descriptors and dataset-specific learned interestingness scores
- **Sampling:** UTE: 5-second segments; SumMe: superframes. Frame-sampling rate Not reported.
- **Architecture:** Nonnegative mixture of interestingness, representativeness and temporal-uniformity set functions.
- **Fusion:** Segment-level visual descriptors and interestingness
- **Objective:** Regularized large-margin learning of nonnegative mixture weights; projected subgradient optimization (Section 3, Eqs. 3–5).
- **Training data:** Annotated SumMe and UTE/VideoSET-derived references
- **Test data:** SumMe 25 and four UTE videos
- **Split:** Cross-testing; paper describes 100 randomized training/inference repetitions. Exact reusable split IDs Not reported.
- **Budget:** UTE: approximately 80 or 120 seconds. SumMe cap Not independently verified.
- **Postprocessing:** Compare lazy greedy selection by raw marginal gain and by gain/cost; return the better feasible set (Algorithm 1).
- **Code url:** Not independently verified
- **Code status:** No official implementation repository verified
- **Framework:** Not reported
- **Weights:** Not independently verified
- **Features:** Mean visual descriptors per candidate segment; downloadable tensors Not independently verified
- **Reproducibility:** Primary paper inspected; no code execution or score reproduction.
- **Limitations:** Learning uses labelled references. Budgeted greedy inference is approximate; text-based evaluation does not directly measure visual quality.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Authors:** Michael Gygli; Helmut Grabner; Luc Van Gool
- **Year:** 2015
- **Supervision:** supervised
- **Tasks:** Generic extractive video summarization
- **Outputs:** Selected temporal segments
- **Mechanisms:** Submodular mixtures; Large-margin learning; Budgeted greedy inference
- **Metrics:** Nearest-reference temporal F1 on SumMe; Text-mapped ROUGE on UTE
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://www.cv-foundation.org/openaccess/content_cvpr_2015/papers/Gygli_Video_Summarization_by_2015_CVPR_paper.pdf)

## Video Summarization with Long Short-term Memory

- **Venue:** ECCV 2016
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~grauman/papers/zhang-eccv2016-lstm-summ.pdf)
- **Project url:** [project url](https://github.com/kezhang-cs/Video-Summarization-with-LSTM)
- **Encoders:** ImageNet-pretrained GoogLeNet pool5, 1024-D
- **Sampling:** 2 fps
- **Architecture:** Bidirectional LSTM plus input-feature/hidden-state MLP predicts importance; dppLSTM adds a learned similarity embedding.
- **Fusion:** Concatenation of visual features and bidirectional recurrent states
- **Objective:** vsLSTM: squared-error importance regression. dppLSTM: regression pretraining followed by DPP maximum likelihood with quality-diversity kernel L_ij = y_i y_j phi_i^T phi_j (Section 3).
- **Training data:** Canonical: target 80% train/validation; augmented: add the other benchmark, OVP 50 and YouTube 39; transfer: other three datasets only.
- **Test data:** SumMe and TVSum
- **Split:** Random 80/20 canonical splits; augmentation/transfer as Table 3. Supplement Section 5.2: five runs per setting and test fold.
- **Budget:** 15% machine-summary duration; released TVSum reference evaluator uses 18%
- **Postprocessing:** KTS segments and budgeted keyshot decoding. The described DPP keyframe-density route differs from released diagonal-score reweighting followed by mean-shot knapsack.
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/kezhang-cs/Video-Summarization-with-LSTM)
- **Code status:** Official source pinned at 0ee0a0948872544567ecede76868287042470f75; no reproduction
- **Framework:** Python 2.7+, Theano 0.7+, MATLAB
- **Weights:** SumMe and TVSum trained model files listed in official tree; binaries not loaded
- **Features:** Advertised 2-fps GoogLeNet HDF5; original idx/fea_i schema. README data-download anchor lacks a file URL.
- **Reproducibility:** Paper, supplement and pinned evaluation source read; no model training, inference or archive integrity check.
- **Limitations:** Small benchmarks; fold hashes unavailable in paper. TVSum reference budget and dppLSTM decoder need explicit versioning for fair comparison.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Authors:** Ke Zhang; Wei-Lun Chao; Fei Sha; Kristen Grauman
- **Year:** 2016
- **Supervision:** supervised
- **Tasks:** Generic extractive video summarization
- **Outputs:** Frame importance scores; Selected keyshots
- **Mechanisms:** Bidirectional LSTM; Determinantal point process
- **Metrics:** Temporal-overlap F1; SumMe maximum across users; Temporal-overlap F1; TVSum mean across users
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~grauman/papers/zhang-eccv2016-lstm-summ.pdf) · [source 2](https://www.cs.utexas.edu/~grauman/papers/zhang-eccv2016-lstm-summ-supp.pdf) · [source 3](https://github.com/kezhang-cs/Video-Summarization-with-LSTM/blob/0ee0a0948872544567ecede76868287042470f75/README.md) · [source 4](https://github.com/kezhang-cs/Video-Summarization-with-LSTM/blob/0ee0a0948872544567ecede76868287042470f75/codes/dppLSTM_eval.m) · [source 5](https://github.com/kezhang-cs/Video-Summarization-with-LSTM/blob/0ee0a0948872544567ecede76868287042470f75/codes/evalTVSum/evaluate_TVSum.m)

## Query-Focused Video Summarization: Dataset, Evaluation, and A Memory Network Based Approach

- **Venue:** CVPR 2017
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1707.04960)
- **Project url:** [project url](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content_cvpr_2017/html/Sharghi_Query-Focused_Video_Summarization_CVPR_2017_paper.html)
- **Encoders:** 70 SentiBank detector scores plus six contextual correlation features
- **Sampling:** Eight frames per 5-second shot; ten shots per sequential segment
- **Architecture:** Query attends to frames through a memory network; resulting shot embeddings parameterize the sequential DPP.
- **Fusion:** Query/frame attention
- **Objective:** Section 4.3: maximize training-summary log likelihood; SGD learns embeddings, validation selects epochs and learning rate.
- **Training data:** QFVS query-summary annotation layer on UTE
- **Test data:** Four UTE source videos with QFVS references
- **Split:** Four rounds: two training, one validation and one test video
- **Budget:** Main experiment unconstrained; separate 10/20-shot annotations reserved for future work
- **Postprocessing:** Sequential shot-subset selection using learned DPP
- **Code url:** Not independently verified
- **Code status:** Paper links dataset/evaluation release at www.aidean-sharghi.com/cvpr2017; endpoint failed fetch
- **Framework:** Not independently verified
- **Weights:** Not independently verified
- **Features:** Feature definition in paper; released tensors Not independently verified
- **Reproducibility:** Primary paper read; no artifact download or execution.
- **Limitations:** Only four source videos; concept-based F1 has a different meaning from temporal-overlap F1.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Authors:** Aidean Sharghi; Jacob S. Laurel; Boqing Gong
- **Year:** 2017
- **Supervision:** supervised
- **Tasks:** Query-focused video summarization
- **Outputs:** Query-conditioned shot subset
- **Mechanisms:** Memory network; Sequential determinantal point process
- **Metrics:** Concept-IoU bipartite-matching precision; Concept-IoU bipartite-matching recall; Concept-IoU bipartite-matching F1
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1707.04960)

<a id="dr-dsn"></a>

## Deep Reinforcement Learning for Unsupervised Video Summarization with Diversity-Representativeness Reward

- **Venue:** AAAI 2018
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://cdn.aaai.org/ojs/12255/12255-13-15783-1-2-20201228.pdf)
- **Project url:** [project url](https://github.com/KaiyangZhou/pytorch-vsumm-reinforce)
- **Encoders:** Frozen ImageNet GoogLeNet pool5, 1024-D
- **Sampling:** 2 fps
- **Architecture:** Bidirectional LSTM with Bernoulli frame-selection policy
- **Fusion:** Visual-only recurrent policy
- **Objective:** REINFORCE maximizes diversity plus representativeness rewards; mean-selection-probability and weight regularization. Section 3 separately adds a human-supervised extension; reward-only results are not that extension.
- **Training data:** Canonical target training videos; augmentation with OVP and YouTube; transfer trains on the other three datasets.
- **Test data:** SumMe and TVSum
- **Split:** Paper: five-fold 80/20 evaluation; exact fold IDs and repeated-seed variance Not reported
- **Budget:** Final summary at most 15% of original frames; training selection regularizer targets probability 0.5, a distinct constraint
- **Postprocessing:** KTS, mean predicted score per shot and 0/1 knapsack.
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/KaiyangZhou/pytorch-vsumm-reinforce)
- **Code status:** Official PyTorch port pinned at 041606fec8e2ba7f4c4900064a76d965a473e53c; original paper used Theano
- **Framework:** Audited port: Python 2.7 / PyTorch 0.4.0
- **Weights:** No pretrained weights advertised in audited README
- **Features:** Author port links replacement Google Drive data for inaccessible QMUL server; HDF5 features and frame/segment metadata advertised, not downloaded.
- **Reproducibility:** Paper and pinned source inspected; later port saves final max-epoch checkpoint. No training or benchmark reproduction.
- **Limitations:** Reward design encodes visual similarity rather than human semantics. Paper reward-based early stopping differs from final-epoch port; augmented data differs from Zhang Table 3.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Authors:** Kaiyang Zhou; Yu Qiao; Tao Xiang
- **Year:** 2018
- **Supervision:** unsupervised; supervised
- **Tasks:** Generic extractive video summarization
- **Outputs:** Frame selection probabilities; Selected keyshots
- **Mechanisms:** Bidirectional LSTM; REINFORCE; Diversity reward; Representativeness reward
- **Metrics:** Temporal-overlap F1; SumMe maximum across users; Temporal-overlap F1; TVSum mean across users

## Summarizing Videos with Attention

- **Venue:** ACCV 2018 AIU workshop; revised LNCS proceedings published 2019, 39–54
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1812.01969)
- **Project url:** [project url](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet)
- **Encoders:** ImageNet GoogLeNet pool5, 1024-D
- **Sampling:** 2 fps using reused HDF5 features
- **Architecture:** Learned dot-product self-attention, projected values, residual connection, dropout, layer normalization and fully connected importance head.
- **Fusion:** Visual-only attention context and input residual
- **Objective:** Mean squared error against human-derived importance scores; official main.py uses nn.MSELoss.
- **Training data:** Canonical target dataset; augmented setting adds other benchmark plus OVP and YouTube
- **Test data:** SumMe and TVSum
- **Split:** Five random 80/20 splits; canonical and augmented settings
- **Budget:** At most 15% of original-frame duration
- **Postprocessing:** KTS metadata; mean score per shot and 0/1 knapsack.
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet)
- **Code status:** Official source pinned at c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d; no reproduction
- **Framework:** Python 3.5.2; PyTorch 0.4.1; OR-Tools 6.9.5824
- **Weights:** Box model ZIP advertised in datasets_models_urls.txt; not downloaded or loaded
- **Features:** Box dataset ZIP advertised; 2-fps GoogLeNet HDF5 plus labels, original-frame indices and KTS metadata
- **Reproducibility:** Paper and pinned source read. Official main.py selects its best epoch by test_keys F1; a validation-only checkpoint protocol must be specified for independent evaluation.
- **Limitations:** Checkpoint selection uses labelled test performance in the inspected release. Old framework versions and attention memory growth limit direct modern use.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Authors:** Jiri Fajtl; Hajar Sadeghi Sokeh; Vasileios Argyriou; Dorothy Monekosso; Paolo Remagnino
- **Year:** 2018
- **Supervision:** supervised
- **Tasks:** Generic extractive video summarization
- **Outputs:** Frame importance scores; Selected keyshots
- **Mechanisms:** Self-attention; Importance regression
- **Metrics:** Temporal-overlap F1; SumMe maximum across users; Temporal-overlap F1; TVSum mean across users
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1812.01969) · [source 2](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet/blob/c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d/README.md) · [source 3](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet/blob/c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d/main.py) · [source 4](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet/blob/c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d/vasnet_model.py) · [source 5](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet/blob/c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d/datasets_models_urls.txt) · [source 6](https://researchinnovation.kingston.ac.uk/en/publications/summarizing-videos-with-attention-4/)

## VideoXum: Cross-modal Visual and Textural Summarization of Videos

- **Authors:** Jingyang Lin; Hang Hua; Ming Chen; Yikang Li; Jenhao Hsiao; Chiuman Ho; Jiebo Luo
- **Venue:** IEEE Transactions on Multimedia 26:5548-5560 (2024); accepted 2023
- **Year:** 2024
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.12060)
- **Project url:** [project url](https://videoxum.github.io/)
- **Supervision:** supervised
- **Tasks:** video-to-video; video-to-text; joint visual-text summarization
- **Outputs:** selected frames; text summary
- **Mechanisms:** multitask supervised learning; vision-language encoder-decoder
- **Encoders:** BLIP visual encoder and pretrained text decoder; VTSUM-BLIP baseline.
- **Sampling:** 1 frame per second in VideoXum representation.
- **Architecture:** Shared video representation feeds frame-importance and text-generation decoders.
- **Fusion:** Shared visual encoding supports jointly aligned visual and text outputs.
- **Objective:** Section IV-B Eqs. (6)-(7): frame binary cross-entropy plus autoregressive text negative log likelihood; overall multitask objective Section IV-C.
- **Training data:** VideoXum human summary annotations derived from ActivityNet Captions.
- **Test data:** VideoXum.
- **Split:** 8,000 train / 2,001 validation / 4,000 test videos (Section III-A).
- **Budget:** Paper: intended top 15% of frames. Inspected F1 helper keeps scores >= the zero-based threshold at floor(0.15*N), selecting floor(0.15*N)+1 frames with distinct scores and possibly more with ties.
- **Postprocessing:** Frame threshold selection, not KTS keyshots. F1 is computed for each human mask and aggregated; the rank-metric path compares scores with the mean of ten masks. VT-CLIPScore uses a separate top-k path.
- **Metrics:** F1; Kendall tau; Spearman rho; BLEU; METEOR; ROUGE-L; CIDEr; VT-CLIPScore
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum)
- **Code status:** Official
- **Framework:** PyTorch; repository documents Python 3.8 / PyTorch 1.10.1.
- **Weights:** Official model zoo on Hugging Face linked by repository.
- **Features:** Author-provided annotations and model/feature preparation instructions.
- **Reproducibility:** Primary paper and selected source inspected at commit 11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df; no model execution or independent result reproduction.
- **Limitations:** Repository badge uses TMM 2023; archival volume is 2024. Released F1 threshold can exceed the intended 15% frame budget. F1 reference averaging and correlation against the mean reference are distinct; neither is the classic KTS keyshot protocol.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/html/2303.12060v3) · [source 2](https://videoxum.github.io/) · [source 3](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum) · [source 4](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum/blob/11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df/utils.py#L255-L281) · [source 5](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum/blob/11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df/eval_v2vt_sum.py#L53-L107)

- **Authors:** Min Jung Lee; Dayoung Gong; Minsu Cho
- **Venue:** CVPR
- **Year:** 2025

- **Project url:** Not independently verified

- **Fusion:** Language bottleneck: frame captions to local windows, then global self-attention.
- **Objective:** Section 3.5 Eq. (6): mean_t (s_t-s_hat_t)^2 against human frame-importance targets.
- **Training data:** SumMe/TVSum; example captions sampled from SumMe training set for in-context prompts.
- **Test data:** SumMe; TVSum; separate Mr. HiSum zero-shot ablation.
- **Split:** Five dataset splits; validation/test independence not established by this audit.
- **Budget:** Standard short-video budget configuration not independently verified.
- **Postprocessing:** KTS and shot aggregation (Section 4.2); primary results emphasize rank metrics.
- **Metrics:** Kendall tau; Spearman rho
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/mlee47/LLMVS)
- **Code status:** Official
- **Framework:** PyTorch; Python 3.8.
- **Weights:** Official README links model checkpoints for dataset splits.
- **Features:** Repository documents captions/LLM embeddings and data download.
- **Reproducibility:** Primary-source and repository inspection only; no model was executed; commit/release pin not independently verified.
- **Limitations:** Frozen LLM components do not make the global aggregator training-free. Paper reports 5 A100 GPUs; caption errors and context-window choices affect results.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/html/2504.11199v2) · [source 2](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2025/papers/Lee_Video_Summarization_with_Large_Language_Models_CVPR_2025_paper.pdf) · [source 3](https://github.com/mlee47/LLMVS)

- **Authors:** Mario Barbara; Alaa Maalouf
- **Venue:** arXiv preprint; initial 2025, inspected revision 2026-02-17
- **Year:** 2025
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.10807)
- **Project url:** Not independently verified
- **Supervision:** training-free; zero-shot
- **Tasks:** generic video summarization; query-focused summarization; fine-grained reasoning-guided summarization
- **Outputs:** scene importance; frame importance; video skim
- **Mechanisms:** prompted semantic scoring; scene captioning; heuristic temporal score refinement
- **Encoders:** CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings; LLaVA/Qwen video captioner; GPT-family scene judge (model ablations).
- **Sampling:** Appendix A.5: 1 fps full video, 2 fps scenes, batches of 80; Section 3.2 also describes 1 fps scene processing, requiring implementation check.
- **Architecture:** Scene detection, scene/global captioning, LLM scene judgment and frame score propagation.
- **Fusion:** Prompt combines scene, global description and optional user query.
- **Objective:** No gradient objective; Sections 3.3-3.4 define prompted scene scoring, normalization, temporal smoothing and consistency/uniqueness frame weighting.
- **Training data:** No selector training; pretrained models. Normalization selected with dataset experiments.
- **Test data:** SumMe; TVSum; QFVS; VidSum-Reason.
- **Split:** No learned selector splits; independence of calibration experiments not established.
- **Budget:** 15% for SumMe/TVSum; 36% for VidSum-Reason, with 3% fragments.
- **Postprocessing:** Scene/frame weighting and temporal-overlap evaluation; exact subset solver not independently verified.
- **Metrics:** F1; precision; recall; Precision-over-Random

- **Framework:** Python/PyTorch, LLaVA-NeXT and OpenAI API.
- **Weights:** Off-the-shelf foundation checkpoints; no task-trained selector checkpoint.
- **Features:** Repository includes benchmark directories and VidSum-Reason resources.
- **Reproducibility:** Primary-source and repository inspection only; no model was executed; commit/release pin not independently verified.
- **Limitations:** Dataset-dependent Min-Max/Exponential normalization; held-out calibration unresolved. README clone command names an older repository. API/model versions and caption-cache provenance required.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08

## SD-VSum: A Method and Dataset for Script-Driven Video Summarization

- **Authors:** Manolis Mylonas; Evlampios Apostolidis; Vasileios Mezaris
- **Venue:** ACM Multimedia
- **Year:** 2025
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.03319)
- **Project url:** Not independently verified
- **Supervision:** supervised
- **Tasks:** script-driven video summarization; generic multimodal summarization
- **Outputs:** selected frames; script-conditioned importance
- **Mechanisms:** supervised script-conditioned scoring; cross-modal attention
- **Encoders:** Frozen VideoXum-finetuned CLIP visual/text encoders; 512-dimensional features.
- **Sampling:** 1 fps.
- **Architecture:** 8-head cross-modal attention, Transformer frame scorer and sigmoid head.
- **Fusion:** Video frames align with sentence embeddings from the desired-summary script.
- **Objective:** Section 4.2: BCE against the matching annotator summary for script-driven task; MSE against average annotator scores for generic variant.
- **Training data:** S-VideoXum: 10 human summaries/video paired with LLaVA-NeXT-Video-generated scripts.
- **Test data:** S-VideoXum; S-NewsVSum; generic VideoXum.
- **Split:** VideoXum train/validation/test partition; each script pairs with its own reference. S-NewsVSum uses 5-fold CV.
- **Budget:** Top 15% of frames.
- **Postprocessing:** Frame ranking; average F1 across script-reference pairs, then videos; not best-reference matching.
- **Metrics:** F1; Kendall tau; Spearman rho
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/IDT-ITI/SD-VSum)
- **Code status:** Official
- **Framework:** PyTorch.
- **Weights:** Official README links pretrained SD-VSum checkpoint.
- **Features:** Zenodo S-VideoXum release includes CLIP H5 features, labels, split JSON and scripts.
- **Reproducibility:** Primary-source and repository inspection only; no model was executed; commit/release pin not independently verified.
- **Limitations:** Machine-generated scripts may encode target-summary artifacts. Generic and script-conditioned losses/references differ; keep results separate.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/html/2505.03319v2) · [source 2](https://doi.org/10.1145/3746027.3755821) · [source 3](https://github.com/IDT-ITI/SD-VSum)

## V2Xum-LLM: Cross-Modal Video Summarization with Temporal Prompt Instruction Tuning

- **Authors:** Hang Hua; Yunlong Tang; Chenliang Xu; Jiebo Luo
- **Venue:** AAAI
- **Year:** 2025
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.12353)
- **Project url:** [project url](https://hanghuacs.github.io/v2xum/)
- **Supervision:** supervised; weakly-supervised
- **Tasks:** video-to-video; video-to-text; joint visual-text summarization
- **Outputs:** frame-index tokens; text summary
- **Mechanisms:** instruction tuning; temporally grounded autoregressive decoding
- **Encoders:** CLIP ViT-L/14@336; Vicuna-v1.5-7B/13B.
- **Sampling:** Downsample input to 100 temporal positions.
- **Architecture:** Frozen visual encoder, trainable adapter and language decoder.
- **Fusion:** Interleave visual tokens with textual frame-index prompts; task instruction controls output modality.
- **Objective:** Training Eq. (4): autoregressive negative log likelihood over output visual-index/text tokens; adapter and language decoder updated.
- **Training data:** LCS-558K adapter pretraining; VideoXum/Instruct-V2Xum summarization training; 30,000-video Instruct-V2Xum uses machine-assisted annotation.
- **Test data:** VideoXum; Instruct-V2Xum; SumMe; TVSum.
- **Split:** Dataset-specific task splits; exact split-file identities not independently verified.
- **Budget:** Task-dependent generated frame indices; exact decoding/budget configuration not independently verified.
- **Postprocessing:** Temporal-index parsing; Appendix derives importance from language-model logits.
- **Metrics:** F1; Kendall tau; Spearman rho; BLEU-4; METEOR; ROUGE-L; CIDEr; F_CLIP; Cross-F_CLIP
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/hanghuacs/V2Xum-LLM)
- **Code status:** Official
- **Framework:** PyTorch; Python 3.9.
- **Weights:** Repository links Hugging Face model.
- **Features:** Dataset and model links available through official project.
- **Reproducibility:** Primary-source and repository inspection only; no model was executed; commit/release pin not independently verified.
- **Limitations:** Fine-tuned summarizer, not zero-shot; semantic CLIP metrics are not temporal-overlap F1. Initial arXiv 2024; AAAI publication 2025; inspected v3 updated October 2025.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/html/2404.12353v3) · [source 2](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/download/32374/34529) · [source 3](https://github.com/hanghuacs/V2Xum-LLM)

## Cut to the Chase: Training-free Multimodal Summarization via Chain-of-Events

- **Authors:** Xiaoxing You; Qiang Huang; Lingyu Li; Xiaojun Chang; Jun Yu
- **Venue:** CVPR
- **Year:** 2026
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06213)
- **Project url:** Not independently verified
- **Supervision:** training-free; few-shot
- **Tasks:** multimodal textual video summarization; cross-domain summarization
- **Outputs:** text summary
- **Mechanisms:** structured event reasoning; hierarchical event graph; cross-modal grounding
- **Encoders:** Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct default; Whisper for missing transcripts; proprietary LLM calls where configured.
- **Sampling:** Up to 72 uniformly sampled frames, initially 12 clips; up to 30 frames per merged clip.
- **Architecture:** Hierarchical Event Graph, spatial grounding, event-evolution reasoning, domain-adaptive summary generation.
- **Fusion:** Explicit alignment of textual events/entities to visual evidence and temporal transitions.
- **Objective:** No gradient loss; Section 3 builds and reasons over event graphs; Section 3.5 uses example-guided style adaptation.
- **Training data:** No gradient training; Section 4.1 samples five training-set summaries as style references.
- **Test data:** VIEWS; MM-AVS; XMSMO-News; TIB; VISTA; BLiSS; SoccerNet-Caption; SummScreen3D.
- **Split:** Dataset test sets with training-set style exemplars; exemplar identity not independently verified.
- **Budget:** Text-generation length/configuration; no 15% extractive duration budget.
- **Postprocessing:** Event-centric generation and style adaptation, then text metrics.
- **Metrics:** BLEU-4; ROUGE; CIDEr; METEOR; BERTScore; entity F1; G-Eval
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/youxiaoxing/CoE)
- **Code status:** Official
- **Framework:** Python 3.12, PyTorch, vLLM; MongoDB-backed data preparation.
- **Weights:** Off-the-shelf Qwen model; no task-trained checkpoint.
- **Features:** Graph construction and evaluation scripts; underlying dataset access/preparation required.
- **Reproducibility:** Primary-source and repository inspection only; no model was executed; commit/release pin not independently verified.
- **Limitations:** Text-only output cannot be ranked with keyshot F1. Training-free does not mean no labeled examples: five reference summaries supply style. Judge versions and paid API components affect reproducibility.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.06213v1) · [source 2](https://github.com/youxiaoxing/CoE) · [source 3](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026/supplemental/You_Cut_to_the_CVPR_2026_supplemental.pdf)

## TripleSumm: Adaptive Triple-Modality Fusion for Video Summarization

- **Authors:** Sumin Kim; Hyemin Jeong; Mingu Kang; Yejin Kim; Yoori Oh; Joonseok Lee
- **Venue:** ICLR
- **Year:** 2026
- **Paper url:** [paper url](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01169)
- **Project url:** [project url](https://sumin-kim.com/TripleSumm-page/)
- **Supervision:** supervised; weakly-supervised; zero-shot
- **Tasks:** generic video summarization; multimodal video summarization; long-form transfer
- **Outputs:** frame importance; keyshots
- **Mechanisms:** supervised importance regression; multiscale temporal attention; adaptive trimodal fusion
- **Encoders:** MoSu: CLIP ViT-L/14, RoBERTa-base, AST; external datasets use existing visual features plus generated captions/audio.
- **Sampling:** MoSu: 1 visual/text/audio feature per second; audio uses centered 10-second windows.
- **Architecture:** Alternating temporal and cross-modal blocks; D=128; sigmoid score head (Appendix A.1).
- **Fusion:** Per-frame fusion tokens combine visual, text and audio; temporal windows grow 5,15,45,N.
- **Objective:** Section 3.3 Eq. (7): L = &#124;&#124;S - S_hat&#124;&#124;_2^2 against importance targets; no reconstruction objective.
- **Training data:** MoSu replay-derived targets; separately target-dataset supervision or MoSu pretraining then target fine-tuning.
- **Test data:** MoSu; Mr. HiSum; SumMe; TVSum; separate 50-video long-form set.
- **Split:** MoSu: 42,152 train / 5,263 validation / 5,263 test. SumMe/TVSum: TV 5-fold (4 train,1 evaluation) versus TVT (3 train,1 validation,1 test), Appendix B.5.
- **Budget:** 15% duration for keyshots (Appendix A.2); mAP uses a distinct segment-ranking protocol.
- **Postprocessing:** KTS, mean shot score, 0/1 knapsack; not applied to raw-score rank correlations.
- **Metrics:** Kendall tau; Spearman rho; mAP@50; mAP@15
- **Code url:** [code url](https://github.com/smkim37/TripleSumm)
- **Code status:** Official
- **Framework:** PyTorch 2.5.1; Python 3.10; CUDA 12.1 (repository).
- **Weights:** Official MoSu and Mr. HiSum checkpoints at https://huggingface.co/smkim37/TripleSumm (MIT); not executed.
- **Features:** MoSu card: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hminjeong/TripleSumm-MoSu; three (N,768) feature arrays per video, metadata, GT and split files; CC-BY-4.0.
- **Reproducibility:** Primary-source and repository inspection only; no model was executed; commit/release pin not independently verified.
- **Limitations:** Supervised/weak target regression; zero-shot denotes MoSu-to-long-video transfer only. Main Table 2 and Appendix Table XI agree, but Appendix D prose gives different MoSu rank values. External-dataset captioner is Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct in Section 5.1 versus the Qwen/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct link in Appendix B.4; resolve model/cache provenance. Missing-modality and feature-extraction costs must be tracked.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.01169v1) · [source 2](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=x74NsHGywD) · [source 3](https://github.com/smkim37/TripleSumm) · [source 4](https://sumin-kim.com/TripleSumm-page/) · [source 5](https://huggingface.co/datasets/hminjeong/TripleSumm-MoSu) · [source 6](https://huggingface.co/smkim37/TripleSumm)
